description: corrField as the Lung250M-4B authors ship it, at a pinned commit, with its defaults: Foerstner keypoints inside the fixed image's lung mask, MIND-SSC, discrete matching, thin-plate splines. The ImagingBenchmarks baseline corrfield, lungs only: the fixed mask is required. The pair must be aligned (rigidly for one patient, by an affine transform between two subjects): only the deformable stage runs. The pair is brought to a grid of at least 1 mm and at most 50 million voxels, and the field back onto the fixed grid. A GPU is needed. Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS).
